# Documentation set (page metadata): junos current
# Junos release shown: not stated
# Retrieved: 2026-10-06
# Assumptions: HIER-1 (hierarchical format)
# Note: Two samples of the page: 'show security policies' then 'show security address-book' (named books attached to zones).
# Note: Text copied verbatim from the page <pre> block (line endings normalized).
# Note: The second sample is indented by 4 more spaces from book2 on, as published.
# ---
[edit]
user@host# show security policies
from-zone trust to-zone untrust {
    policy permit-mail {
        match {
            source-address mail-trust;
            destination-address mail-untrust;
            application junos-mail;
        }
        then {
            permit;
        }
    }
}
user@host# show security address-book
book1 {
    address mail-untrust 203.0.113.14/24;
    attach {
        zone untrust;
    }
}
    book2 {
        address mail-trust 192.168.1.1/32;
        attach {
            zone trust;
        }
    }
